title: 第78章 小宝贝别跑，咱们聊聊！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 狄苍，秦牧，程茂站在远处，大眼瞪小眼。见到唐逸开始走独木，开始翻越障碍，秦牧忍不住嘲讽道：“狄苍，这就是你叫我们两个老家伙，来蹲点蹲守的练兵之法？”“呵呵，这小子要真懂什么练兵之法，老子把整张桌子都给吃了。”秦牧有点生气，当时他都请旨逃随军北上，是狄苍说了让他们留下来，有非常重要的事情需要和他们研究。结果，就特妈研究一个少年在扯淡！还说肯定是什么练兵之法，这算哪门子的练兵之法？狄苍抬手拍了拍脑袋，有点尴尬，难道真是自己想错了？程茂看着唐逸将带绳的巨大木轮套在肩膀上，拼命拖着前进，嘴角的笑容却渐渐收敛了。他一直以为这所谓的训练之地，就是个玩具场，见唐逸跑了一圈，再将唐逸跑的轨迹和方法在脑海中过了一遍之后，他脸色渐渐凝重起来。“不对，这可能是炼体之术。”“嗯？”狄苍和秦牧齐齐看向程茂。“炼体之术，你开什么玩笑？那东西早就失传了。”秦牧震惊，声音都拔高了几分。传言数千年前，商国大将殷创出炼体之术，练出了最为精锐的鬼嵬军，所到之处战无不胜攻无不克。千年前，大将赵阙又得到炼体之术，练出了白矛军，爬山越岭如履平地，万军丛中取上将首级。数百年前，前唐大将李唐获得炼体之术，练出了裂山军和锁龙阵，军阵联合，进可攻，退可守，打得北方蛮夷哭爹喊娘，向北迁徙三万里！可以说，炼体之术，是每个将帅打碎脑袋都想要得到的东西。现在，却被一个少年捣鼓出来了？开什么玩笑。狄苍面色凝重，但老眼却目光如炬，道：“都记住他是怎么跑的了吧？走，我们按照他的方式，跑一次。”狄苍已经快步向着训练场走去，秦牧嘴里虽然说着不相信，身体却格外诚实，甚至比狄苍和程茂还要快那么几分。三人进了训练场，便开始按照唐逸之前的方式，开始跑了起来。唐逸现在身体不行，训练场过一圈都费劲，但还是咬牙坚持完成，听到身后的动静他往后看了一眼，便见到身后三个老者按照他的方式正在健步如飞。“妈的，这老人欺负人啊这是！”唐逸脸皮抽搐，贼老天，这是看老子前世太强了，把老子丢到这世界找虐的？而狄苍，秦牧，以及程茂按照唐逸的方法跑了一圈后，彼此相视一眼，面色都充满震惊和惊骇！“我……我草了，竟然是真的？！”秦牧下巴都要掉下来了。妈的，那是炼体术，炼体术啊！无数将领想要得到，想要搞出来的东西，竟然就让这小子这么给搞出来了？炼体术……特妈什么时候这么不值钱了？“老……老狄，这小子，真真只有十八岁？而不是一百八十岁吗？”程茂看着拖着重轮艰难前行，全身都被汗水湿透的唐逸，喉咙下意识滚动了下：“看着这小子，老子都觉得自己这辈子算是白活了。”狄苍没有说话，只是下意识地摸了摸雪白的胡须，心头却早已经惊涛骇浪。从炎文帝对唐逸的重视，他就知道唐逸很不简单，但也没想到这么不简单，出口就是绝世华章，出手就是炼体之术。文能扫天下，武能平四海……当然，武是谋略的意思，不是武功。老天爷，大炎这次算是捡到宝了。“走，和这兔崽子好好聊聊。”狄苍一挥手，三个糟老头子立即气势汹汹向唐逸围了过去。唐逸拖着木轮刚过线，正想进入下一环节，就看到三个老头搓着手掌围了过来，将他包围住，那目光就像是见到绝世美女一般。“小宝贝，别跑，站在那里，咱们好好聊聊。”听到狄苍这话，唐逸身上的疲惫一扫而光，当场就清醒了。他浑身恶寒，警惕盯着三个老头道：“呃，狄老，你们……你们这是要干嘛？我是正经人，对老头不感兴趣。”此时此刻，唐逸忽然有点想念幻音阁的三大花魁了。一战三，他选择花魁。“小子，不干嘛，你别躲。”狄苍一把将唐逸捞起来，将他随手丢在不远处的座椅上，道：“炼体术，你是从哪里搞到的？别说是你自己弄的，你才十八岁，战场都没上过，你能弄出这东西？”唐逸听到这话给愣住了。炼体术，那是什么？想到狄苍三人刚刚亲自试验了他的训练场，唐逸顿时反应过来，指了指训练场道：“你们，是说这个？”这不就是后世军人的训练场吗？只不过他是以特种训练的标准设置的罢了。这在你们眼中竟然这么宝贝？炼体术，这么说好像也没有错。前世训练场考验的就是体能，可特妈你们这世界有武功啊！会飞的好吗！不过想一想，唐逸还是觉得可能是自己先入为主了，这个世界是有武功没错，可是武功不是所有人都会。不然，这世界早乱套了。“嗯嗯嗯……”三个老头头点得如同哈士奇，满脸讨好的表情。唐逸自然不能说前世的事，笑着摊了摊手道：“狄老，秦老，程老，实不相瞒，这就是我瞎捣鼓出来的东西而已。”“我身体不好，就想捣鼓一点东西出来锻炼身体，仅此而已。”至于上战场……实不相瞒，我在战场上杀掉的敌人，不见得就比你们三人少。你们有武功，但前世我有热武器！狄苍和秦牧三人相视一眼，眼底都充满震撼。妈的，没上过战场的毛孩子，将他们心心念念的炼体术搞出来了。是他们疯了，还是这个世界疯了？！狄苍不认为唐逸在说谎，唐逸在唐家的遭遇，他多少知道一些的……不，不对，谁说这小子没上过战场？他在唐家遭到无数次凌辱，那就是他的战场。要经过多少次欺辱，他才能痛定思痛搞出这一套炼体术的？“唐敬这混蛋，简直就不是人。”狄苍抬手拍了拍唐逸的肩膀，道：“小子，这些年你受苦了，以后有事找我们，我们就是你的后盾。”“还有，这训练场的训练规则，你写出来，老夫要用。”唐逸看向对面的训练场，又看了一眼远处正在杂乱无章胡乱训练的将军府亲兵，就知道了狄苍想要干什么。他想要用训练场，来练他的兵？
content_en: Di Cang, Qin Mu, and Cheng Mao stood in the distance, staring at each other with big eyes.Seeing Tang Yi starting to walk on a single log and climbing over obstacles, Qin Mu couldn't help but mocked: "Di Cang, is this the way you asked us two old guys to squat and stay here to train troops?" "Haha, if this kid really knows how to train troops, I will eat the whole table." Qin Mu was a little angry. At that time, he requested an order to escape and follow the army northward. It was Di Cang who told them to stay. There are very important things that need to be studied with them.As a result, I was just studying a teenager who was talking nonsense!He also said that it must be some kind of military training method. What kind of military training method is this?Di Cang raised his hand and patted his head, feeling a little embarrassed. Could it be that he had thought wrong?Cheng Mao watched Tang Yi put the huge wooden wheel with a rope on his shoulder and drag it forward with all his strength, but the smile on his face gradually faded.He always thought that this so-called training place was just a toy field. When he saw Tang Yi running around in a circle, and then replayed Tang Yi's trajectory and method in his mind, his face gradually became serious."No, this may be a body refining technique." "Huh?" Di Cang and Qin Mu both looked at Cheng Mao."The art of body refining, are you kidding me? That thing has been lost a long time ago." Qin Mu was shocked and his voice rose a little higher.It is said that thousands of years ago, General Yin of the Shang Kingdom created the art of body refining and trained the most elite Guiwei army, which was invincible wherever he went.Thousands of years ago, the general Zhao Que obtained the art of body refining and trained the White Spear Army. He climbed mountains and ridges as if walking on flat ground, and took the general's head from the crowd of thousands of troops.Hundreds of years ago, Li Tang, the former Tang general, acquired the art of body refining and developed the Mountain Splitting Army and Dragon Locking Formation. The combined military formations allowed them to attack when advancing and defend when retreating. The barbarians in the north cried for their fathers and mothers and migrated 30,000 miles north!It can be said that the art of body refining is something that every general wants to get if he breaks his head.Now, it was tricked by a young man?What a joke.Di Cang's face was solemn, but his old eyes were bright, and he said: "You remember how he ran, right? Come on, let's run in his way." Di Cang was already walking quickly towards the training ground. Although Qin Mu said he didn't believe it, his body was extremely honest, even faster than Di Cang and Cheng Mao.The three of them entered the training ground and started running according to Tang Yi's previous method.Tang Yi was not in good health now, and it was difficult to complete a lap of the training ground, but he still gritted his teeth and insisted on finishing. When he heard the movement behind him, he glanced back and saw three old men behind him walking as fast as he did."Damn, this old man is bullying people!" Tang Yi's face twitched, God, is this because I was too strong in my previous life, so why did you throw me into this world to seek abuse?After Di Cang, Qin Mu, and Cheng Mao ran around according to Tang Yi's method, they looked at each other, their faces full of shock and horror!"I...I'm so confused, it's true?!" Qin Mu's jaw almost dropped.Damn it, that’s the body refining technique, the body refining technique!Countless generals wanted to get something, but they let this kid do it like this?Body refining... When did Te Ma become so worthless?"Old...Old Di, is this kid really only eighteen years old? Instead of one hundred and eighty?" Cheng Mao looked at Tang Yi, who was dragging the heavy wheel forward with difficulty, his whole body soaked with sweat, and his throat rolled subconsciously: "Looking at this kid, I feel that my life has been in vain." Di Cang did not speak, but subconsciously touched his snow-white beard, but his heart was already in a turmoil.From the importance Emperor Yan Wen paid to Tang Yi, he knew that Tang Yi was not simple, but he never expected that it was so extraordinary. His words were peerless splendor and his moves were body-refining techniques.Literature can sweep the world, martial arts can level the world... Of course, martial arts means strategy, not martial arts.God, Dayan found a treasure this time."Let's have a good chat with this bastard." Di Cang waved his hand, and the three bad old men immediately surrounded Tang Yi aggressively.As soon as Tang Yi dragged the wooden wheel across the line and was about to enter the next step, he saw three old men rubbing their palms together and surrounding him. Their eyes were like seeing a peerless beauty."Baby, don't run, just stand there and let's have a good chat." After hearing Di Cang's words, Tang Yi's fatigue disappeared and he woke up on the spot.He felt a chill all over his body and stared at the three old men warily: "Uh, Mr. Di, you... what are you doing? I am a serious person and I am not interested in old men." At this moment, Tang Yi suddenly missed the three oirans of Huanyin Pavilion.In a battle of three, he chose the Oiran."Boy, what are you doing? Don't hide." Di Cang picked up Tang Yi and threw him on a seat not far away, saying: "Where did you get the body refining technique? Don't say you did it yourself. You are only eighteen years old and have never been on the battlefield. How can you come up with this thing?" Tang Yi was stunned when he heard this.Body refining, what is that?Thinking that Di Cang and the others had just personally tested his training ground, Tang Yi immediately reacted, pointed at the training ground and said, "You, are you talking about this?" Isn't this the training ground for future generations of soldiers?It's just that he was set according to the standards of special training.Is this so precious in your eyes?It seems that it is not wrong to say that it is a physical refining technique.In the previous life, the training ground tested physical fitness, but Mom, you have martial arts in this world!Can you fly?But thinking about it, Tang Yi still felt that he might have preconceived ideas. There is martial arts in this world, but not everyone can do it.Otherwise, the world would have been in chaos."Hmm, hmm..." The three old men nodded like huskies, with fawning expressions on their faces.Tang Yi naturally couldn't talk about the past life, so he smiled and spread his hands and said: "Old Di, Old Qin, and Old Cheng, let's be honest, this is just something I made up." "I'm not in good health, so I just want to make some things to exercise, that's all." As for going to the battlefield... To be honest, I killed fewer enemies on the battlefield than the three of you.You have martial arts, but I had hot weapons in my previous life!Di Cang and Qin Mu looked at each other with shock in their eyes.Damn it, these idiots who have never been on the battlefield have figured out the physical training technique that they have been dreaming about.Are they crazy, or is the world crazy?!Di Cang didn't think Tang Yi was lying. He knew something about Tang Yi's experiences in the Tang family... No, that's not right. Who said this kid had never been on the battlefield?He was humiliated countless times in the Tang family, and that was his battlefield.How many times does it take him to be bullied before he can learn from the experience and do this?
title_en: Chapter 78 Baby, don’t run away, let’s talk!
